why_it_fails: Wrong endpoint, not a failed extraction. Resolution adopted the first '/menu/'-shaped link on the retailer site (locators._known_menu_candidates marks links matching r'/menu/' as 'matched'), which is the brand chooser stashouse.com/menu/ - a static WordPress page. The page contains only guide copy for both Moline and Maryville and no products, so the generic structured/DOM path returns RENDER_BLANK. The real shop is one hop further (stashouse.com/stores/revolution-dispensary-moline), whose SSR HTML has a single dispensaryId that site_discovery.dutchie_page_endpoints() would convert to dutchie.com/embedded-menu/698a691ac95a14de84898e8d. No CONNECTORS entry exists ('^stash\b' does not match 'Stashouse').
fix_idea: (1) Resolver: when a candidate menu page has zero products but links to a /stores/<slug> storefront whose JSON-LD street matches the registry, follow it; never accept a hub/chooser page as a menu endpoint (it lists several branches' addresses). (2) Run dutchie_page_endpoints on the followed page and store the endpoint as dutchie + dispensaryId (embedded-menu URL) rather than the retailer URL. (3) Dutchie whole-menu replay must drop landing-view filters (isOnSpecial, collectionId) and use the unscoped query; do not trust the first observed query's totalCount (623 vs real 1341). (4) Optionally supersede the saved generic endpoint using Store.supersede_endpoint.
